summary: The index measures the performance of a diversified, liquid and cost-effective long exposure to the broad commodities market through synthetic positions in futures contracts, with no single commodity or sector dominating the index. Under normal market conditions, the fund generally invests substantially all, but at least 80%, of its net assets, directly or indirectly, in securities and/or other instruments comprising the index. The fund is non-diversified.
